threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You keep calling it a 'subway' instead of the Tube – it’s a sure sign you’re not from around here.
Last week on the 196, a guy serenaded the whole bus with 'Wonderwall' but forgot the words halfway through. We all joined in for the chorus.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I saw a guy walking his pet peacock down Wutzkyallee, I knew this place was unlike anywhere else. Only in Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin will you find a spontaneous techno party in a public pool at 2 AM, complete with floaties and DJs in swim trunks.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s from SF if they can name at least three BART delays this month without hesitation. The tourists still think it’s all about the cable cars.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy on the 10 bus calmly juggling while his friend tried to sing. Only in the Tenderloin do your morning commutes come with live entertainment.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think the best tapas are in restaurants, but the real gems are in local corners, often overshadowed by fancy facades.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can spot them by their wide-eyed amazement at the street performers in Plaça Catalunya, while the locals just shrug and walk past.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You always queue at the bus stop, not realizing it's a free-for-all. Locals just jump in wherever, and good luck if you're last in line.
Last night on the N37, a guy serenaded the bus with a saxophone. Just another Tuesday in Brixton, but the driver didn’t even bat an eyelid.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: I knew I was home when I saw a guy playing an accordion while his dog tried to steal a pretzel from a cyclist at the Körnerpark.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: You know it’s Berlin when you're at a café and the barista asks for your favorite street name instead of your order. It’s a vibe!

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can tell a true local by their indifference to BART delays; if they're still on time for brunch, they've been through worse.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Just saw a dude with a pet parrot on the 49. The bird squawked every time the brakes squealed—made me realize we're all just navigating chaos together.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think every café is for sitting and sipping. Locals know the best spots are just for picking up a quick café amb llet to go.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can always tell by the way they order cider as 'sidra' instead of just calling it 'manzana'. It’s the little things.
